verses.saheeh: By the night when it covers
verses.khattab: By the night when it covers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿By the night as it enshrouds, with its darkness all that is between the heaven and the earth,
verses.romanUrdu: Kasam hai raat ki jabke woh chaa jaaye

verses.saheeh: And [by] the day when it appears
verses.khattab: and the day when it shines
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and [by] the day as it unveils, [as] it is revealed and becomes manifest (idhā, ‘as’, in both instances is an absolute adverbial, operated by the verbal action of the oath),
verses.romanUrdu: Aur din ki jabke woh roshan ho

verses.saheeh: And [by] He who created the male and female,
verses.khattab: And by ˹the One˺ Who created male and female
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and [by] the One Who (mā either functions as man, ‘the One Who’, or it is related to a verbal action) created the male and the female, Adam and Eve, or every male and female — the hermaphrodite, although problematic for us, is [in fact] either male or female according to God, and therefore a person [actually] commits perjury if he speaks with one [thinking that] because he has sworn not to speak with a male or a female; [he may do so with a hermaphrodite].
verses.romanUrdu: Aur us zaat ki jisne nar(male) aur maada(female) ko paida kiya

verses.saheeh: Indeed, your efforts are diverse.
verses.khattab: Surely the ends you strive for are diverse
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Assuredly your efforts, your deeds, are dissimilar, with some working towards Paradise by means of obedience, while others [in effect] are working towards the Fire through [acts of] disobedience.
verses.romanUrdu: Dar haqeeqat tum logon ki koshishein mukhtalif qism ki hai

verses.saheeh: As for he who gives and fears Allah
verses.khattab: As for the one who is charitable, mindful ˹of Allah˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿As for him who gives, what is due to God, and is fearful, of God,
verses.romanUrdu: To jisne (rah e khuda mein) maal diya aur (khuda ki nafarmani se) parhez kiya

verses.saheeh: And believes in the best [reward],
verses.khattab: and ˹firmly˺ believes in the finest reward
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and affirms the truth of the best [word], that is, [the truth] of ‘there is no god but God’ (in both places [here and below, verse 9]),
verses.romanUrdu: Aur bhalayi ko sach mana

verses.saheeh: We will ease him toward ease.
verses.khattab: We will facilitate for them the Way of Ease
verses.jalalayn: ﻿We shall surely ease his way to [the abode of] ease, to Paradise.
verses.romanUrdu: Usko hum aasan raastey kay liye sahulat denge

verses.saheeh: But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need
verses.khattab: And as for the one who is stingy, indifferent ˹to Allah˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿But as for him who is niggardly, with what is due to God, and deems himself self-sufficient, without need for His reward, [92:9] and denies the best [word],
verses.romanUrdu: Aur jisne bukhl(kanjoosi) kiya aur (apney khuda se) be niyazi(self-sufficient/independent) barti

wbw.translation: and considers himself free from need

verses.saheeh: And denies the best [reward],
verses.khattab: and ˹staunchly˺ denies the finest reward
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and denies the best [word],
verses.romanUrdu: aur bhalayi ko jhutlaya

verses.saheeh: We will ease him toward difficulty.
verses.khattab: We will facilitate for them the path of hardship
verses.jalalayn: ﻿We shall surely ease his way, We shall pave for him the way, to hardship, to the Fire;
verses.romanUrdu: Usko hum sakht rastey kay liye sahulat dengey

verses.uthmani: وَمَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
verses.indopak: وَمَا يُغْنِىْ عَنْهُ مَالُهٗۤ اِذَا تَرَدّٰى ۗ
verses.saheeh: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls?
verses.khattab: And their wealth will be of no benefit to them when they tumble ˹into Hell˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And his wealth shall not (mā is or negation) avail him when he perishes, in the Fire.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur uska maal aakhir uske kis kaam aayega jabke woh halaq ho jaye

verses.saheeh: Indeed, [incumbent] upon Us is guidance.
verses.khattab: It is certainly upon Us ˹alone˺ to show ˹the way to˺ guidance
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Truly with Us lies [all] guidance, the pointing out of the path of guidance from that of error, so that Our command may be followed by adhering to the former [manner of conduct] and that Our prohibition [may also be heeded] by refraining from falling into the latter [manner of conduct].
verses.romanUrdu: Beshak rasta batana hamare zimmey hai

verses.saheeh: And indeed, to Us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
verses.khattab: And surely to Us ˹alone˺ belong this life and the next
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And truly to Us belong the Hereafter and the first [life], that is to say, [that of] this world, and so whoever seeks either of the two from anyone other than Us has erred.
verses.romanUrdu: aur dar haqeeqat aakhirat aur duniya dono kay hum hi malik hai

verses.saheeh: So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing.
verses.khattab: And so I have warned you of a raging Fire
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So I have warned you of, I have threatened you, O people of Mecca, [with], a raging fire (talazzā, ‘raging’: one of the two original tā’ letters [of tatalazzā] has been omitted; a variant reading retains it, tatalazzā, that is, ‘one that is flaming’),
verses.romanUrdu: Pas maine tumko khabardar kar diya hai bhadakti hui aag se

verses.saheeh: None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one.
verses.khattab: in which none will burn except the most wretched—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿which none shall enter but the wretched one (al-ashqā means al-shaqī),
verses.romanUrdu: Usmein nahin jhulsega magar woh intihayi badbakth

verses.saheeh: Who had denied and turned away.
verses.khattab: who deny and turn away
verses.jalalayn: ﻿he who denies, the Prophet, and turns away, from faith — this delimiting [of those who deserve to enter this fire] constitutes an interpretation of His saying, But He forgives other than that to whomever He will [Q. 4:48], which in turn suggests that what is meant is that entry [into the Fire] which will be everlasting.
verses.romanUrdu: jisne jhutlaya aur mooh phera

verses.saheeh: But the righteous one will avoid it -
verses.khattab: But the righteous will be spared from it—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿The God-fearing one (al-atqā means al-taqī) shall be spared it, he will be removed far away from it,
verses.romanUrdu: Aur usse door rakkha jayega woh nihayat parhezgaar

wbw.translation: But will be removed from it

verses.saheeh: [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself
verses.khattab: who donate ˹some of˺ their wealth only to purify themselves
verses.jalalayn: ﻿he who gives his wealth to purify himself, offering it as a [means of self] purification before God, exalted be He, by making this payment for the sake of God, exalted be He, and not for show or the sake of reputation, so that he [or the offering] stands purified in the sight of God. This [verse] was revealed regarding the truthful one (al-siddīq) [Abū Bakr], may God be pleased with him, when he purchased Bilāl [the Ethiopian], who was being tortured on account of his faith, and then freed him, whereat the disbelievers said, ‘He only did this in return for a favour which he [must have] owed him’, and so the following was revealed:
verses.romanUrdu: Jo paakiza honay ki khatir apna maal deta hai

verses.uthmani: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعۡمَةٖ تُجۡزَىٰٓ
verses.indopak: وَمَا لِاَحَدٍ عِنْدَهٗ مِنْ نِّعْمَةٍ تُجْزٰۤى ۙ
verses.saheeh: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded
verses.khattab: not in return for someone’s favours
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and no one has any favour [outstanding] with him that must be requited;
verses.romanUrdu: Uspar kisi ka koi ehsan nahin hai jiska badla usey dena ho

verses.saheeh: But only seeking the countenance of his Lord, Most High.
verses.khattab: but seeking the pleasure of their Lord, the Most High
verses.jalalayn: ﻿but, he did this, only seeking the pleasure of his Lord the Most High, that is to say, only seeking [to secure] God’s reward;
verses.romanUrdu: Woh to sirf apne Rubb-e-bartrar ki raza joii ke liye yeh kaam karta hai

verses.saheeh: And he is going to be satisfied.
verses.khattab: They will certainly be pleased
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and verily [soon] he shall [himself] be pleased, with the reward he will be given in Paradise. The verse applies [equally] to anyone who may do as he [Abū Bakr] did, may God be pleased with him, and such [a person] will thereby be removed far from the Fire and rewarded.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur zaroor woh (us se) khush hoga
